# Vendored files

| File | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axe.min.js` | npm package [`axe-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/axe-core) by Deque Systems (`package/axe.min.js`) | 4.13.0 | MPL-2.0, see `axe-core.LICENSE` and `axe-core.LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt` |

The file is unmodified. It is what `@axe-core/playwright` injects into the page; CodeCheck injects it the same way
from Python. To update: download `https://registry.npmjs.org/axe-core/-/axe-core-<version>.tgz`, check its
`shasum` against `https://registry.npmjs.org/axe-core/<version>`, and copy the three files from `package/`.
